parameters.jsCode: const errors=[];const isObj=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);const sb=isObj($json.story_bible)?$json.story_bible:null;if($json.schema_version!=='1.0')errors.push('Invalid schema_version: expected 1.0.');if($json.route!=='story_bible.created')errors.push('Invalid route: expected story_bible.created.');if($json.status!=='ready')errors.push('Invalid status: expected ready.');if($json.is_valid!==true)errors.push('Input contract must be valid.');if(!sb)errors.push('story_bible must be an object.');for(const f of ['story_bible_uuid','novel_uuid','workspace_uuid'])if(!sb||typeof sb[f]!=='string'||!sb[f].trim())errors.push(`story_bible.${f} is required.`);if(!sb||!isObj(sb.sections))errors.push('story_bible.sections must be an object.');if(!isObj($json.context))errors.push('context must be an object.');return[{json:{...$json,contract_valid:errors.length===0,validation_errors:errors}}];

const errors=[...$json.validation_errors];const isObj=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);const s=$json.story_context.sections;if(!isObj(s?.overview))errors.push('sections.overview must be an object.');if(!isObj(s?.canon))errors.push('sections.canon must be an object.');for(const f of ['characters','world','timeline'])if(!Array.isArray(s?.[f]))errors.push(`sections.${f} must be an array.`);if(!isObj(s?.conflicts))errors.push('sections.conflicts must be an object.');if(!isObj($json.story_context.index))errors.push('index must be an object.');if(!isObj($json.story_context.summary))errors.push('summary must be an object.');if(!Array.isArray($json.story_context.invalid_knowledge_records))errors.push('invalid_knowledge_records must be an array.');return[{json:{...$json,contract_valid:$json.contract_valid&&errors.length===0,validation_errors:errors}}];

const stableId=value=>{let h=2166136261;for(const ch of String(value).normalize('NFKC').toLocaleLowerCase()){h^=ch.codePointAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return(h>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0')};const errors=[...$json.validation_errors];if($json.contract_valid&&!$json.existing_root_folder_id)errors.push('existing_root_folder_id is required; refusing arbitrary Google Drive placement.');const valid=$json.contract_valid&&errors.length===0;const c=$json.story_context??{};const idempotencyKey=String($json._bootstrap_context?.idempotency_key??`${c.novel_uuid}|chapter|${c.chapter_number}`);return[{json:{...$json,request_valid:valid,validation_errors:errors,persistence_id:valid?`KPS-${stableId(idempotencyKey)}`:'',persistence_upsert_key:idempotencyKey,requested_at:new Date().toISOString(),knowledge_root_plan:{existing_root_folder_id:$json.existing_root_folder_id,required_paths:['03_Canon','03_Canon/Knowledge','04_Characters','05_World','06_Outline','09_Backup']}}}];

const errors=[...$json.validation_errors];const q=$json.execution_queue;const uniq=(a)=>new Set(a).size===a.length;if(!Array.isArray(q))errors.push('execution_queue must be an array.');else{if(!uniq(q.map(x=>x.queue_id)))errors.push('Queue IDs must be unique.');if(!uniq(q.map(x=>x.operation_id)))errors.push('Operation IDs must be unique.');if(!uniq(q.map(x=>x.relative_path)))errors.push('Relative paths must be unique.');if(!uniq(q.map(x=>x.sequence))||q.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x.sequence)||x.sequence<1))errors.push('Sequences must be unique positive integers.');if(q.some(x=>x.required&&(!x.resource_name||!x.parent_reference)))errors.push('Required files need names and parent references.');if(q.some(x=>!['application/json','text/markdown'].includes(x.mime_type)))errors.push('Unsupported content type.');}return[{json:{...$json,request_valid:$json.request_valid&&errors.length===0,validation_errors:errors}}];

const incoming=$input.all();const sources=$('Expand Folder Operations').all();const base=sources[0]?.json??{};const map={...(base.resolved_folder_map??{})};const results=[];for(let i=0;i<incoming.length;i++){const value=incoming[i].json??{};const op=sources[i]?.json?.folder_operation??{};const id=String(value.id??'');if(op.folder_path&&id)map[op.folder_path]=id;results.push({folder_path:op.folder_path??'',status:id?'success':'failed',resource_id:id,resource_url:id?`https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${id}`:'',error_message:id?'':String(value.error?.message??value.message??'Folder create or resolution failed.')});}const kid=map['03_Canon/Knowledge']??'';return[{json:{...base,resolved_folder_map:map,folder_results:results,knowledge_root_folder_id:kid,knowledge_root_folder_url:kid?`https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${kid}`:''}}];

parameters.content:
## Intake and validation
Accept only a valid WF-010 Story Bible contract.

## Planning
Build ten canonical file operations and deterministic content.

## Google Drive Execution
Resolve workspace folders and create or replace files without embedded credentials.

## Verification and Output
Required-file success controls the stable WF-012 result.
